test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Rectify
solution: The correct answer is '**Corrupt**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Rectify**' is '**Corrupt**'. • **Rectify**: to correct something that is wrong. (अशुद्घ को शुद्घ करना) • *Example: No simple apology was going to **rectify** this situation.* • **Corrupt**: doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money, etc. (धन के बदले ग़ैर-कानूनी काम करना अथवा संलिप्त होना; भ्रष्‍ट) • *Example: **corrupt** officials who accept bribes...* **Correct Answer:__** *Corrupt.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Assist**: to help. (सहायता करना) • **Correct**: with no mistakes; right or true. (शुद्घ, त्रुटिहीन; सही या सत्‍य) • **Select**: to choose somebody/something from a number of similar things. (एक जैसे व्‍यक्तियों या वस्‍तुओं में से एक को चुनना; चयन करना) 15d:T558, The correct answer is** 'To have control of something'.**
